column1: # ---- review cut (2026-10-16): rows that let a rename-only overlay go. Rows marked [shared] are also proposed for the
# migrator's shared/1.21.3 table (API changed in 1.21.2); they stay here until the fork's shared copy carries them.
# [shared] a boolean use of Entity.hurt (void since 1.21.2) is hurtServer's result; a "did health drop?" stand-in is wrong
# [shared] an Entity.hurt override (final since 1.21.2) is a hurtServer override
# [shared] GeckoLib 4.7+ (1.21.3/1.21.4): GeoModel resource getters take the renderer;
# SoundEvent is a record since 1.21.2: getLocation() -> location() (this mod's own sounds; not a bare row)
# [shared] InteractionResultHolder is gone (1.21.2): an item's use returns an InteractionResult; a success carrying the
# held stack is the same result (a different stack is heldItemTransformedTo)
# Player.sendSystemMessage is ServerPlayer-only from 1.21.2 to 1.21.11 (26.x has it on Player again, and no
# displayClientMessage): send it through the ServerPlayer, which every target has. These calls run on the server.
# [shared] ItemCooldowns is keyed by stack since 1.21.2
# Entity.noCulling is gone (1.21.2); both lightning entities draw through LightningBoltRenderer, which is never culled
# [shared] Recipe.canCraftInDimensions and Entity.getBoundingBoxForCulling are no longer overridable (1.21.2): keep the method
# [shared] BlockBehaviour light/skylight queries lost their BlockGetter and BlockPos (1.21.2)
# [shared] MobEffect.applyEffectTick and Mob.doHurtTarget take the ServerLevel (1.21.2)
# [shared] GuiGraphics.blit takes the render type first (1.21.2), also when the texture is built in place
# [shared] a ShaderStateShard over a vanilla core shader names the CoreShaders key (1.21.2); before the shared helper row
# (written fully qualified so the shared helper row `new RenderStateShard.ShaderStateShard(` does not take it again)
